title: GOD LOOKS UPON A BROKEN HEART

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted." Luke 18:14 (NKJV)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Two men went up to the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

The Pharisee stood proudly, trusting in his own righteousness. His prayer echoed only with the word "I." There was no repentance, no hunger or thirst for God's mercy. He returned home exactly as he had come unchanged.

The tax collector, however, stood at a distance. He would not even lift his eyes toward heaven but beat his breast and prayed, "God, be merciful to me, a sinner."

To him alone the door of God's mercy was opened, because he humbly confessed his sin. Confession is not weakness; it is the strength to seek forgiveness. One truth remains: a humble confession can shatter years of pride.

The tax collector saw nothing except God and his own sin. His only desire was forgiveness. God heard his sincere confession. At that very moment, God was waiting for him to forgive him, cleanse him, and lift him up.

Even today, God is waiting for your genuine repentance for your tears, for your willingness to lay aside pride and self-righteousness, and to cry out only for His mercy.

Come to God now. Come without delay. He will never cast away anyone who comes to Him with a sincere and repentant heart.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "The confession of evil works is the first beginning of good works." - Augustine of Hippo

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You know the deepest secrets of my heart. I no longer want to hide anything from You. I confess my sins and wait before You until You make me clean. I come seeking Your grace that alone can cleanse me. Receive me, forgive me, restore me, and lift me up. In Jesus' name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: God will never reject a heart that is filled with love, truth, and genuine repentance.
Today, begin to walk in freedom and purity, knowing that you are completely forgiven!
